summary_1line: Samvarta agrees to officiate Marutta’s sacrifice despite Indra’s opposition and directs him to worship Shiva at the sacred Himalayan peak Munjaban.

image_candidates.scene_text: The ascetic Samvarta warns King Marutta that Indra’s wrath may fall upon them if he performs the king’s sacrifice.
On the Himalayan peak Munjaban, Shiva sits with Uma among caves and giant trees, surrounded by ghostly goblins and celestial beings.
Radiant golden mines shine on all sides of the sacred mountain while Kuvera’s fierce attendants guard them with uplifted arms.
